name: MpConfigSync
author: omp
description: Host automatically pushes mod config values to all peers at multiplayer run start, preventing state divergence from mismatched local config values. Settings: a master switch plus independent sending and receiving group switches, all default ON. Consumer/synchronization patch classes are registered per group at process start; the receive direction retains one resident protective guard because BaseLib's external handler calls the receive entry point even when receiving is OFF, and that guard only blocks the entry and performs no synchronization: turning a group OFF takes effect immediately (mid-session), while a group that was OFF at process start needs a game restart before it can be turned ON. Peers apply the host's values in memory for the current session only; their cfg files are never rewritten, and their own values are restored when the run ends. If a protective guard cannot be installed or verified, the affected direction fails closed (the receive direction is hard-blocked) instead of falling back to the legacy master-switch-only path.
